# discord_role_everyone (Resource)

Manages the permissions of a server's `@everyone` role. The role always exists, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the permissions unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lock the server down: @everyone can only see the welcome channel, which grants
# access through its own permission overwrite.
resource "discord_role_everyone" "everyone" {
  server_id   = var.server_id
  permissions = provider::discord::permissions(["READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (String) Permission bitfield as a decimal string. Use `provider::discord::permissions([...])` to build it.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role ID (identical to the server ID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_role_everyone.everyone <server_id>
```
